lines.zh: 我拖着箱子走，锁链在身后拖响。
lines.en: I haul a crate along, its chain dragging behind me.

lines.zh: 泥水漫到脚踝，我照样走直线。
lines.en: Mud rises to my ankles, and I keep a straight line.

lines.zh: 我扛着补给，肩膀歪向一边。
lines.en: I carry supplies with one shoulder pulled low.

lines.zh: 甲板下太窄，我侧身挪过去。
lines.en: The hold is too narrow, so I move through sideways.

lines.zh: 靴子破了个洞，我踩得一响一响。
lines.en: My boot has a hole, and every step slaps wetly.

lines.zh: 我绕开活人，先护住怀里的袋子。
lines.en: I go around the living, shielding the bag at my chest.

lines.zh: 潮气重，我的骨头走起来吱吱响。
lines.en: The damp is heavy, and my bones creak as I walk.

lines.zh: 我沿着船肋走，数到第十二根停住。
lines.en: I walk the ship's ribs and stop at the twelfth.

lines.zh: 一箱钉子的重量，我掂得出。
lines.en: I can weigh a crate of nails by the heft alone.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为钥匙挂得太多。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I carry too many keys.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着碎玻璃，我踩过去不看。
lines.en: Broken glass is buried in the sand; I walk over it blind.

lines.zh: 我把货担换个肩，继续往前。
lines.en: I shift the load to my other shoulder and keep going.

lines.zh: 走路时我还在念昨天的账。
lines.en: Even walking, I am reciting yesterday's accounts.

lines.zh: 海草缠住脚踝，我一脚踹开。
lines.en: Weed wraps my ankle, and I kick it loose.

lines.zh: 我踩过湿木板，响声很闷。
lines.en: I step across wet planks with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我数着甲板的钉，一步步走。
lines.en: I count the deck nails as I walk.

lines.zh: 我蹲下清点箱子，少了一枚钉子。
lines.en: I crouch to count a crate and find one nail missing.

lines.zh: 没人来领东西，我还是守着。
lines.en: No one comes to claim anything, and I keep watch anyway.

lines.zh: 我咬开绳结，用牙齿比刀快。
lines.en: I bite through knots; my teeth beat any knife.

lines.zh: 风把账页吹走一页，我懒得追。
lines.en: The wind takes a page of the ledger, and I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 我用指甲在木箱上又刻一道。
lines.en: I carve one more mark into the crate with a nail.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔盐渍的嘴唇，觉得渴。
lines.en: I lick my salt-crusted lips and feel thirsty.

lines.zh: 我听见舱里有动静，就没动。
lines.en: Something moves in the hold, and I stay still.

lines.zh: 这袋子里是空的，我不说出去。
lines.en: This sack is empty, and I will not say so.

lines.zh: 我把沉了的货记成待捞。
lines.en: I enter the sunken cargo as pending salvage.

lines.zh: 我数到三十七，然后忘了数到哪。
lines.en: I count to thirty-seven, then lose my place.

lines.zh: 我磨着牙，磨到牙根发凉。
lines.en: I grind my teeth until the roots go cold.

lines.zh: 一只螃蟹爬过箱子，我让它过。
lines.en: A crab crosses the crate, and I let it pass.

lines.zh: 我把钥匙串翻过来，听它响。
lines.en: I flip the key ring over just to hear it ring.

lines.zh: 我对着空气报了一遍库存。
lines.en: I read the inventory aloud to nobody.

lines.zh: 你的手是空的，我看了就烦。
lines.en: Your hands are empty, and that annoys me.

lines.zh: 我在看你的腰带，那里能挂东西。
lines.en: I am looking at your belt; it could hold things.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我往后退半步。
lines.en: You stand too close, so I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我抬头认了认，你不在名册上。
lines.en: I look up and check; you are not on the roster.

lines.zh: 你身上有酒的味，我记住了。
lines.en: You smell of rum, and I have noted it.

lines.zh: 我眯眼量你的块头，算你能扛多少。
lines.en: I squint and size you up for how much you could carry.

lines.zh: 你的鞋是新的，我想换一双。
lines.en: Your boots are new, and I would trade for them.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想问价，忘了你不买。
lines.en: I open my mouth to quote a price, then recall you are not buying.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸，找有没有盖章。
lines.en: I study your face for an official stamp.

lines.zh: 你没带凭证，那就别开口。
lines.en: You carry no papers, so do not start talking.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的记账。
lines.en: That blow interrupts my bookkeeping.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙，把疼咽回去。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是我装货的那只手。
lines.en: You cut the hand I load cargo with.

lines.zh: 血滴在沙上，我看了看颜色。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the sand, and I check its color.

lines.zh: 我退后，先护住怀里的袋子。
lines.en: I back off, guarding the bag at my chest.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，我照旧站着。
lines.en: A bone cracks, and I stay on my feet.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想咬人，这是老毛病。
lines.en: Pain makes me want to bite, which is an old fault.

lines.zh: 我数了数，你欠我一下。
lines.en: I count it up: you owe me one.

lines.zh: 我吐掉嘴里的血，重新张嘴。
lines.en: I spit out the blood and open my mouth again.

lines.zh: 这伤口得记在账上，利息另算。
lines.en: This wound goes in the ledger, with interest separate.

lines.zh: 你那袋子里装的是什么，打开。
lines.en: What is in that sack of yours? Open it.

lines.zh: 你把饼干举高，我踮了一下脚。
lines.en: You raise the biscuit, and I rise onto my toes.

lines.zh: 我只收好的，烂的我不要。
lines.en: I take only good stock; I will not have the rotten.

lines.zh: 铁器的味道让我牙根发痒。
lines.en: The smell of iron sets my teeth itching.

lines.zh: 你给我一瓶酒，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Give me a bottle and I will forget I saw you.

lines.zh: 那串钥匙挺新，谁给你的？
lines.en: That key ring looks new. Who gave it to you?

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，这东西值三枚。
lines.en: I take a sniff; this is worth three coins.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我就知道轻重。
lines.en: Shake it once and I will tell you the weight.

lines.zh: 给我看看，我只是看看。
lines.en: Let me have a look. I am only looking.

lines.zh: 你要是肯换，我就少咬一口。
lines.en: If you are willing to trade, I will bite you one time less.

lines.zh: 你撞洒了我的货，先别走。
lines.en: You spilled my stock, so do not walk away.

lines.zh: 我肩膀顶回去，箱子晃了一下。
lines.en: I shove back with my shoulder, and the crate rocks.

lines.zh: 让开，我背上的东西比你先到。
lines.en: Move; what is on my back arrives before you do.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，没打算道歉。
lines.en: I step on your foot and have no intention of apologizing.

lines.zh: 撞上来的时候，我牙先动了。
lines.en: When you bump me, my teeth move before I think.

lines.zh: 你从左边挤，我从右边挤，堵住了。
lines.en: You push from the left, I push from the right, and we jam.

lines.zh: 我一歪，怀里的罐头滚了一地。
lines.en: I tip sideways and the tins roll everywhere.

lines.zh: 别推，箱子里有玻璃。
lines.en: Do not shove; there is glass in that crate.

lines.zh: 我稳住下盘，你可撞不动我。
lines.en: I set my stance; you will not move me.

lines.zh: 这一碰我记住了位置，回头算账。
lines.en: I have marked where you hit me, and I will settle it later.

lines.zh: 我们公事公办，配完还要清点。
lines.en: We keep this professional; there is stock to count after.

lines.zh: 她管钥匙，我管箱子，正好一对。
lines.en: She keeps the keys, I keep the crates; a fair pair.

lines.zh: 我替她咬开缠住的绳。
lines.en: I bite through the cord tangled around her wrist.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，各自数各自的口袋。
lines.en: We sit side by side, each counting a separate pocket.

lines.zh: 她说话时我在记账，耳朵没停。
lines.en: She talks while I keep the ledger, and my ears stay open.

lines.zh: 生下来的小东西，直接编进名册。
lines.en: The small ones go straight into the roster when they come.

lines.zh: 她多要了一成，我没还价。
lines.en: She asks for an extra tenth, and I do not haggle.

lines.zh: 我们把两张吊床绑在一根梁上。
lines.en: We lash two hammocks to the same beam.

lines.zh: 她说我咬人太狠，我说是习惯。
lines.en: She says I bite too hard; I tell her it is habit.

lines.zh: 这算是搭档，不算别的。
lines.en: This counts as partnership, and nothing more.

lines.zh: 我捡起钉子，顺手放进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a nail and put it in my mouth out of habit.

lines.zh: 落在地上的都属于我，规矩如此。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the deck is mine; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我捡起那半块面包，吹了吹。
lines.en: I pick up half a loaf and blow the sand off.

lines.zh: 一枚扣子，能换半杯东西。
lines.en: One button will trade for half a cup of something.

lines.zh: 我把箱子翻正，里面的东西归我。
lines.en: I right the crate, and its contents become mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起刀鞘，刀已经不在了。
lines.en: I pick up a sheath; the blade is long gone.

lines.zh: 你掉了钱袋，我捡得很自然。
lines.en: You drop a purse, and I pick it up as if it were natural.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，太轻，还是收了。
lines.en: I weigh it, find it light, and pocket it anyway.

lines.zh: 潮水推来一只靴子，我正好要。
lines.en: The tide brings in a boot, and I happen to need one.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进袋子，袋子已经满了。
lines.en: I stuff it into the sack, which is already full.

lines.zh: 你拿着东西不放，那就是目标。
lines.en: You will not let go of that, so you are the target.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你的包，不是你的命。
lines.en: It is your bag I want, not your life.

lines.zh: 名字不在册上，事情就好办。
lines.en: If your name is off the roster, this gets simple.

lines.zh: 你退后时我听见了，目标就是你。
lines.en: I heard you step back, and that makes you the one.

lines.zh: 这一票我不声张，先看你有没有伴。
lines.en: I keep this quiet and first check whether you came alone.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的货，账得清。
lines.en: You crushed my goods, and the account must be settled.

lines.zh: 我咬住下唇，把你放进待处理。
lines.en: I bite my lip and file you under pending.

lines.zh: 你的手往腰后摸，那我也动了。
lines.en: Your hand goes behind your waist, and so does mine.

lines.zh: 我看准了，就没人能改。
lines.en: Once I have picked, no one changes it.

lines.zh: 目标身上有铁，正好我用得上。
lines.en: The target carries iron, which I can use.

lines.zh: 我把箱子放下，空出手来。
lines.en: I set the crate down and free my hands.

lines.zh: 我贴着船舷绕，不让你有退路。
lines.en: I hug the rail and circle so you have no way back.

lines.zh: 牙关先动，再说话就晚了。
lines.en: My jaw moves first; talking comes too late after that.

lines.zh: 我在算你的步数，三步就到。
lines.en: I am counting your steps; three brings me there.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，那下面更软。
lines.en: You raise a hand to your face, and what is beneath is softer.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会招来别人。
lines.en: I stay quiet; a shout would bring the others.

lines.zh: 我往里压，把距离缩到一臂。
lines.en: I press in and close the distance to one arm's length.

lines.zh: 你先动的手，这话我记住了。
lines.en: You struck first, and I have noted the words.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的手腕，不是眼睛。
lines.en: It is your wrist I watch, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你还有一次机会，把东西放下。
lines.en: You have one chance left: put it down.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的小臂，牙齿在骨头上滑。
lines.en: I bite your forearm, teeth sliding along the bone.

lines.zh: 这一口先算利息，本钱还没还。
lines.en: That bite is interest; the principal is still unpaid.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块布，连皮带肉。
lines.en: I tear away cloth, and skin with it.

lines.zh: 你喊了一声，我听见了，没停。
lines.en: You cry out; I hear it and do not stop.

lines.zh: 我用肘把你撞到舱门上。
lines.en: My elbow puts you into the cabin door.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬到铁的滋味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: My teeth find iron, and I do not care for the taste.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到你松手。
lines.en: I keep my grip until your hand opens.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，比货好闻。
lines.en: You smell better than the cargo does.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，好把角度找正。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to correct my angle.

lines.zh: 这一口是为了那箱摔碎的罐头。
lines.en: That bite was for the crate of smashed tins.

lines.zh: 我从舱口探出头，先问今天几号。
lines.en: I put my head through the hatch and ask the date.

lines.zh: 潮水把箱子推上岸，我跟着上来。
lines.en: The tide pushes a crate ashore, and I come with it.

lines.zh: 名册上多了一行，那就是我。
lines.en: A new line appears on the roster, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我抱着账本从船底爬出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the bilge with the ledger in my arms.

lines.zh: 黑暗中先响的是钥匙串。
lines.en: In the dark, the keys are the first thing to sound.

lines.zh: 我站直身子，骨头一节节归位。
lines.en: I straighten up and my bones settle one by one.

lines.zh: 船舱的霉味跟我一起出来了。
lines.en: The hold's mildew comes out with me.

lines.zh: 我落地时，怀里的瓶子碎了一个。
lines.en: On landing, one bottle in my arms breaks.

lines.zh: 有人在清点货物，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone is counting cargo, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我立在沙滩上，先数了数脚印。
lines.en: I stand on the beach and count footprints first.

lines.zh: 烧着的货我最心疼，人倒其次。
lines.en: The burning cargo hurts most; the burning me, less.

lines.zh: 落地时我先摸了摸箱子，怕它摔坏。
lines.en: I hit the ground checking the crate before my ribs.

lines.zh: 水一进舱，我就先找能浮的木箱。
lines.en: Water floods in, and I grab a crate that floats.

lines.zh: 气浪散了，我趴着找我的钥匙。
lines.en: The blast clears, and I crawl looking for my keys.

lines.zh: 箭钉进箱子，货漏了，比伤我还糟。
lines.en: The arrow pierces a crate; the spill is worse than the wound.

lines.zh: 那种亮光烧过皮肤，像被墨烫。
lines.en: That glow burns across my skin like hot ink.

lines.zh: 我早不饿了，可还是想咬点什么。
lines.en: I am past hunger and still want something to bite.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我第一反应是护住钥匙。
lines.en: Thunder hits, and my first move is to cover the keys.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在算损失。
lines.en: As I fall, I am still tallying the losses.
